series_1.title: I სერია (series I)
body: Georgian groups its verb forms, the screeves (მწკრივები), in three series. Series I has the present group (present, imperfect…) and the future group (future, conditional…).
In series I the subject is in the nominative and the direct object in the dative: *ის წერილს წერს* (*he writes a letter*).
Most future forms are the present with a preverb in front: *ვწერ* → *დავწერ*, *ვაკეთებ* → *გავაკეთებ*. The preverb (და-, გა-, მო-, წა-…) depends on the verb and has to be learnt with it.

present.title: აწმყო (present)
body: *ვწერ* — *I write, I am writing*. Georgian has one present for both.
ვ- marks *I* and *we*, -ს marks *he/she*, -თ marks the plural of *we* and *you*, and -ენ (or -ან) marks *they*.

imperfect.title: უწყვეტელი (imperfect)
imperfect.summary: What was going on, or used to happen.
body: *ვწერდი* — *I was writing, I used to write*. It is formed from the present with -დ- and its own endings:

future.title: მყოფადი (future)
body: *დავწერ* — *I will write*. Usually the present with a preverb: *ვწერ* → *დავწერ*, *ვაკეთებ* → *გავაკეთებ*. Some verbs change more: *ვსვამ* (I drink) → *დავლევ* (I will drink).
The preverb also makes the action complete: *დავწერ* is *I'll write it (and finish)*.

series_2.title: II სერია (series II)
body: Series II has the aorist (a completed action in the past) and the optative (wishes, *let's…*, *I should…*).

With most verbs that have an object, the subject of series II is in the ergative case: *მან დაწერა* (*he wrote*), *მათ დაწერეს* (*they wrote*), instead of ის and ისინი. With მე, შენ, ჩვენ, თქვენ nothing changes.

aorist.title: წყვეტილი (aorist)
aorist.summary: A completed action in the past.
body: *დავწერე* — *I wrote*. It keeps the preverb of the future:
In the aorist the direct object is in the nominative: *მან წერილი დაწერა* (*he wrote a letter*).

optative.title: II კავშირებითი (optative)
body: *დავწერო* — *(that) I write, should I write?* It is used after *უნდა* (must): *უნდა დავწერო* (*I have to write*), and for suggestions: *დავწეროთ!* (*let's write!*).

series_3.title: III სერია (series III)
body: Series III has the perfect forms (*apparently…, I have…*). Here the person who does the action is in the dative, as with *მიყვარს* (*I love*).

perfect.title: I თურმეობითი (perfect)
perfect.summary: What has happened, or apparently happened.
body: *დამიწერია* — *I have written (it)*. It also tells something you didn't see yourself: *ის წასულა* (*apparently he has left*).
The person is marked as with *მიყვარს*: *დამიწერია* (I have written), *დაგიწერია* (you have written), *დაუწერია* (he has written).
